countBy.description: host | instance - Whether the cluster alert is based on an alert count across devices or instances

dataPointName.description: The name of the dataPoint you want to base the cluster alert on

dataSourceId.description: The id of the dataSource you want to base the cluster alert on

dataPointId.description: The id of the dataPoint you want to base the cluster alert on

minAlertLevel.description: The alert level that must be present for the devices or instances to trigger the cluster alert. Acceptable values are: 2, 3, 4

dataSourceDisplayName.description: The display name of the dataSource you want to base the cluster alert on

disableAlerting.description: Whether or not alerting will be disabled

id.description: The id of the cluster alert configuration

suppressIndAlert.description: Whether or not alerting will be suppressed for individual alerts, the default value is true

thresholdType.description: whether the alert expression should be evaluated as a total number of devices or instances (absolute) or as a percentage of devices or instances (percentage). Acceptable values are: absolute, percentage

dataPointDescription.description: The description of the dataPoint you want to base the cluster alert on

alertExpr.description: The expression that indicates the number of objects (devices or instances) that need to be in alert to trigger the cluster alert. E.g. > 5
